# Projects

_A simple PWA for easy access to commonly used projects. 📱_

</div>

&nbsp;

## What it is

A tiny Vite + TypeScript PWA that lists my projects (`src/projects.ts`) as links. Live at [pwa.webry.com](https://pwa.webry.com).

## How to run it
1. `pnpm install`
2. `pnpm dev`
3. `pnpm build` / `pnpm preview`
